description:
Ownership chain for an entity: the chain up to the ultimate parent, plus
    its direct subsidiaries. $5.00 per request. Get the ID from
    xrplme_entity_lookup first.
      XRPL   : 5 XRP  via x_payment_signature + x_inv_id
      Solana : $5.00 USDC via x_sol_payload
      Base   : $5.00 USDC via x_base_tx

    Args:
        entity_id: The 20-character entity ID returned by xrplme_entity_lookup.
name: xrplme_entity_ownership
